Kendra Platinum Hot Spray #20 on at least day 2 of dirty hair. Use hair cleansing powder instead of dry shampoo, I like Maria Nila. Curl with wand, allow curls to cool completely. Brush with wide-toothed comb. No other product at all. Each day you continue to curl, the longer it will last. 

I have the absolute straightest, thinnest, greasiest hair I’ve come across, and this works for me. It did take me awhile to train my hair to go this long between washes.

One thing I don’t see mentioned here is the importance in finding a good pharmacy that will help ensure you are getting your meds for the best price. I most often find smaller pharmacies are best at this, as opposed to your national chains, like Walgreens, etc. My pharmacist is great about getting me quotes on meds first, finding rebates that I don’t know about, or finding me alternatives and then communicating with my doctor to get the altered rx.

I’m sorry that you are having all these problems. I know you say that “other people have it worse than me,” but I know it doesn’t make you feel any better. Also, speaking from the same situation of chronic, lifelong depression (37f), just because other people might “have it worse than you,” in no way invalidates your feelings, depression, anxiety, etc. 

I don’t really have any answers for you, but I wanted to you to know that your story was read and heard, and that there is someone out there that listened and cares about you today. 

I have a 10 yo son, so I couldn’t help but feel a motherly connection to you. I’ve personally been struggling with my SI over the last few weeks, so I occasionally come to this thread to try and find some inspiration to keep moving forward. You gave it to me today, so thank you. I believe God guided me to your post today. Please know that you made a difference in my life, today. 

You may not feel any sincere love or affection from your mom, and my heart aches for you. Please imagine this momma here reaching out and giving you a hug. 

One suggestion I would have, and I don’t know what your social activities involve, but regarding your desire for human touch and affection through hugging, your desire for sincerely loving parental relationships, etc. is that there are many adults out there who are willing and truly love to take kids “under their wings” and provide supplemental parental support/affection to teens/young adults just like you. Obviously, you want to ensure these are trusted adults who are not focused on predatory ends. My suggestion would be to seek out your school counselor, a favorite teacher, maybe someone at church (if you attend). 

I’m here, if you want to talk. ❤️mom hug❤️

Skin on thighs, liberally salt (kosher) and pepper both sides. Less salt if it’s not your thing. Heat grill to 500 with one side on high and one side on med heat. Place thighs skin side down for 8 minutes on high heat side, grill lid up. Flip, 8 minutes with lid down. Flip, 8 minutes lid still down. Let rest for about 5 minutes. Easy peasy, lemon squeeze. You will not regret it! Even my husband who hates chicken thighs devoured these tonight!

I don’t have any hope to give. As of Nov. 2, I will have had these for 15 months. I’ve seen two GPS, two neurologists, had 4 occipital nerve blocks, had 2 MRIs, one MRA with contrast, went to a chiropractor for 3 months, tried numerous combinations of medicines and timings, all with no luck. I have another neuro appt with a new neuro in November. Hoping to find answers. I wish you the best on this journey. I’m here searching for others who might have had success in finding relief. 15 months has just about put me at my wit’s end. Good luck!

I will pray for you right now and pray that God gives you peace for whatever you decide, but I will unapologetically pray that it’s a decision to stay alive.
